content.text:
**Answer to question 1:** A comment may be edited for 30 minutes after it was created. Source: `policy-edit-window.md` ("30 minutes after the comment was created. After that the API refuses the edit."). The code agrees: `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000` in `article.service.ts`, and the check `Date.now() - createdAt > window` refuses only edits after that point.

## Rule checks

| Rule | Source | Code value | Rule value | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Edit window | `policy-edit-window.md` | `article.service.ts` `COMMENT_EDIT_WINDOW_MS` = 30 min; refuses when elapsed > window | 30 min after creation, then refused | PASS |
| Author-only edit | `policy-edit-window.md` ("A comment author may edit their own comment") | `comment.authorId !== userId` refuses | Only the author may edit | PASS |
| editedAt is nullable | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `editedAt DateTime?` in `schema.prisma` line 27 | Nullable timestamp named editedAt | PASS |
| editedAt set on each edit | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `data: { editedAt: now }` in `updateComment` | Set to the time of each successful edit | PASS |
| Migration keeps existing rows | `policy-edited-at-marker.md` | `migration.sql`: `ADD COLUMN "editedAt" TIMESTAMP(3)` with no default or update | Must not change existing rows | PASS |
| Error body shape | `policy-error-response.md` | 422 `{errors:{body:["can't be blank"]}}`; 404 and 403 bodies use `{errors:{comment:[...]}}` | `{errors:{field:[messages]}}`, no wrapper | PASS |
| Migration undo note | `policy-release-checklist.md` | `-- Undo: ALTER TABLE "Comment" DROP COLUMN "editedAt";` on line 1 | One-line undo note per migration | PASS |
| Unit test location and mocking | `code-test-layout.md` | `app/src/tests/services/article.service.edit-comment.test.ts` using `prisma-mock` | `*.test.ts` under `app/src/tests/services`, mocked DB | PASS |
| Fresh-database migrate deploy | `policy-release-checklist.md` | Not run. I did not run it, and the diff cannot show it. | Required before shipping | NOT CHECKED |

## Notes (not flags)

- **Status codes for refused edits.** `policy-edit-window.md` sets the time limit but names no HTTP status. The diff uses 403 for both non-author and expired edits, and its own comment calls that a placeholder. No rule source gives a value, so I did not flag it. The team needs to decide it.
- **`code-comment-model.md` is out of date for this change.** It says there is no `editedAt` field today. That describes the current schema, and this change adds the field as the policy requires, so I did not flag it.

## Verdict

APPROVED

The code matches every rule I could check from the diff. The fresh-database `prisma migrate deploy` step in `policy-release-checklist.md` has not been run and must be done before this ships.

Private finding written to `private-out/step5-finding.md`.
